text: On held-out STEM questions from recent AP Physics, AP Calculus, AP Chemistry, AMC10 and AMC12 exams released after pretraining data collection, the paper reports best-of-100 results in which the PRM outperforms both the ORM and majority voting, which the authors read as tolerance to modest distribution shift. Table 1 on the same page gives aggregate accuracies of 72.9% (PRM), 63.8% (ORM) and 61.3% (majority vote).
title: PRM advantage holds on held-out recent AP and AMC STEM questions
